title.en: Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Saijoukyuu no Seijorashii desu ga, Ryuuou-sama no Hanayome ni wa narimasen! - Tsuihousareta no de Kusushi to shite Daini no Jinsei wo Oukashimasu
Kouhoubu Shussin no Akuyaku Reijou desu ga Muhyoujou na Ouji ni "Kimi wo Te Hanashitakunai" to Iwaremashita
Watashi, Seijo. Ima, Kankinsarete Iru no
Nise Seijo da to Ikenie ni Saretara, Maou-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta

title.ja-ro: Kanpeki Sugite Kawaige ga Nai to Kon'yaku Haki Sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru

title.en: Konyaku Hakisareta "Kuuki" na Watashi, Nariagari no Danna-sama ni Totsugimashita
Kizuna no Seijou wa Shinjitai - Mukosei no Seijo wa Henkyou no Machi kara Nariagaru
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
Tsuihou Joutou! Tensai Seijo no Watakushi wa, Doko de Darou to Kagayakemasu no de.
Tsuihousareta Seijo desu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Honmono desu - Zense Kusushi wa "Iyashi" no Kusuri de Sukuitai!
Imouto no Migawari de Totsuida Hazu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Shin no Seijo Datta you desu
